blush-field.$description: Blush Field — Hero section background, full-bleed section dividers, decorative border washes — the warm pastel that sets the emotional temperature for the whole site

vermilion-mark.$description: Vermilion Mark — Sole chromatic accent — brand wordmark, link underlines, arrow icons, scroll indicator. One warm note against all the near-monochrome

mint-accent.$description: Mint Accent — Rare card or section background — the only cool note permitted, used sparingly for tonal variety

charcoal-ink.$description: Charcoal Ink — Primary body text, heading text, default borders, icon strokes — the workhorse warm-black neutral

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, content section backgrounds, floating pill nav fill

jet-black.$description: Jet Black — Strong borders, high-emphasis text, icon fills — the maximum-contrast neutral

bone-gray.$description: Bone Gray — Subtle off-white surface for nested content blocks beneath white sections

custom47163.$description: Primary body and heading face — used for all UI text, section headlines, links, and the scroll indicator. The custom face brings a distinctive ampersand ligature and a slightly humanist warmth that keeps the editorial tone approachable rather than austere. Substitutes: Söhne, GT America, Maison Neue.

custom47178.$description: Exclusive display wordmark face — the 'Worth' hero text only. A custom commissioned face at exhibition scale with extreme tight tracking. This is the signature element: no other text on the site approaches this scale. Substitutes: Söhne Breit, GT America Compressed, Druk Wide.

apple-system.$description: System font fallback for icons, the small 'Agency' label in the floating pill, and micro-UI elements where the custom face isn't loaded. Kept neutral so the custom face can carry all the brand expression.
